messages.subject: Day segment analyses with GGIR
parts:
Hi all,

I wonder if anyone have the experience about Day segment analyses with GGIR guided by activity log. Is it possible to make the start time of a day to be wake-up time and the end time of a day to be in bed time according to the activity log, rather than having the start time of a day to be 0:00 and end time to be 24:00? I have tried many ways, but the start and end time of day can't be changed.

Sincerely,
Julia

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Day segment analyses with GGIR
parts:
Hi Julia,

Currently the start time of the day can not be changed. Although, we could enhance GGIR to facilitate such use-case. Possible routes:
  • You or someone else develops it and makes a pull request on GitHub.
  • I do it as a paid consultancy after August as my schedule is full at the moment. If you are interested then direct message me to discuss. 

Best,
Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
